name: smwgraphics-samurai-chuck
title: Samurai Chuck
description:
Anorakun's Notes: Chuck got tired of sports and decided to learn the way of bushido, thus, becoming a samurai. This one uses custom palette. Made by No Body The Dragon.

UPDATE: Includes all the types of Chuck. Do note that Clappin' Chuck hands have priority above the head, so it may look slightly weird. A patch / hex edit was added with this submission to fix the Diggin' Chuck shoulder tilemap.
